text.en:
Paragraph 3 (6) of Executive Order No. 95, dated
October 13, 1947, as amended by Executive Order No. 130,
dated April 21, 1948, is hereby further amended accord-
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of July, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forsy-eight, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLo
Executive Secretary
